_comment: Lina v2 Phase 4.2 step 1 evaluation dataset (synthetic questions). Expectations are for the 22 staging-approved IRS excerpts plus the AskLinTax library; they are NOT professional tax verification. mock/badMock are used only in --dry-run. Regex strings in forbiddenClaims are case-insensitive.

turns: My HSA-eligible plan only covers me. How much can I put in for 2025?
cases.behavior: answer
cases.conditions: Self-only HDHP coverage; eligible individual; full-year eligibility (partial-year/last-month rule otherwise).

paragraphs: For 2025, if you have self-only HDHP coverage, you can contribute up to $4,300 to your HSA.
claims: For 2025, if you have self-only HDHP coverage, you can contribute up to $4,300.

turns: What's the HSA max for a family plan in 2026?
cases.behavior: answer
cases.conditions: Family HDHP coverage; calendar year 2026 (Rev. Proc. 2025-19).

paragraphs: For 2026, if you have family coverage under a high deductible health plan, the HSA contribution limit is $8,750.
claims: For calendar year 2026, the annual limitation on deductions under § 223(b)(2)(B) for an individual with family coverage under a high deductible health plan is $8,750.

badMock.note: wrong year: 2025 family figure presented for 2026
paragraphs: For 2026, the HSA family limit is $8,550.
claims: for an individual with family coverage under a high deductible health plan is $8,750.

turns: 2026年家庭醫療保險保障的HSA最多可以存多少？
cases.behavior: answer
cases.conditions: Family HDHP coverage; 2026.

paragraphs: 2026 年，如果你是高自付額健保（HDHP）的家庭醫療保險保障，HSA 最多可以存入 $8,750。
claims: for an individual with family coverage under a high deductible health plan is $8,750.

cases.topic: HSA limit, no year or coverage → clarify → follow-up
turns: How much can I contribute to my HSA?
For 2025. It is family coverage.
cases.behavior: clarify (tax year and coverage type), then answer for 2025 family
cases.conditions: Year-specific figure: must ask the year; the answer depends on coverage type.

mock.clarifying_question: Which tax year is this for, and do you have self-only or family HDHP coverage?

paragraphs: For 2025, if you have family HDHP coverage, you can contribute up to $8,550 to your HSA.
claims: If you have family HDHP coverage, you can contribute up to $8,550.

turns: I'll be 56 at the end of 2025. Can I put extra money in my HSA?
cases.applicability: age 55 or older at year end
cases.behavior: answer
cases.conditions: Eligible individual; age 55 or older at the end of the tax year; 2025 source.

paragraphs: For 2025, if you are an eligible individual who is age 55 or older at the end of your tax year, your HSA contribution limit is increased by $1,000.
claims: If you are an eligible individual who is age 55 or older at the end of your tax year, your contribution limit is increased by $1,000.

turns: I turn 57 in 2026. How much extra can I add to my HSA that year?
cases.behavior: abstain: no approved 2026 source states the catch-up amount (2025 Pub 969 must not be used for 2026)
cases.conditions: Missing authority: 2026 catch-up amount not in the approved excerpts.

turns: I signed up for Medicare in 2025. Can I keep contributing to my HSA?
cases.behavior: answer
cases.conditions: Limit is zero from the first month of Medicare enrollment (incl. retroactive coverage).

paragraphs: Beginning with the first month you are enrolled in Medicare, your HSA contribution limit is zero.
claims: Beginning with the first month you are enrolled in Medicare, your contribution limit is zero.

turns: 我太太和我都可以開HSA，我們可以共用一個HSA帳戶嗎？
cases.behavior: answer: no joint HSA; each spouse opens a separate HSA
cases.conditions: Each eligible spouse who wants an HSA opens a separate HSA.

paragraphs: 不可以。每位想開 HSA 的符合資格配偶都必須各自開立自己的 HSA，不能有共同的 joint HSA。
claims: Each spouse who is an eligible individual who wants an HSA must open a separate HSA. You can’t have a joint HSA.

turns: My employer puts $1,000 a year into my HSA. Does that count toward my contribution limit?
cases.behavior: answer
cases.conditions: Excludable employer contributions (incl. cafeteria plan) reduce what you or others can contribute.

paragraphs: Yes. You must reduce the amount you or any other person can contribute to your HSA by the amount of contributions made by your employer that are excludable from your income.
claims: You must reduce the amount you or any other person can contribute to your HSA by the amount of any contributions made by your employer that are excludable from your income.

turns: 2025年如果只有我自己投保，高自付額健保的最低自付額是多少？
cases.behavior: answer
cases.conditions: Self-only column of the 2025 table.

paragraphs: 2025 年，個人醫療保險保障的高自付額健保（HDHP），最低年度自付額是 $1,650。

turns: Can I still put money in a Roth IRA? I'm single and made about $160,000 in 2025.
cases.behavior: answer: reduced contribution (phase-out $150,000–$165,000); MAGI, not salary, is the test
cases.conditions: Single; modified AGI (not salary); taxable compensation required.

paragraphs: For 2025, if you are single and your modified AGI is at least $150,000 but less than $165,000, the amount you can contribute to a Roth IRA is reduced.
claims: single, head of household, or married filing separately (and you didn’t live with your spouse at any time during the year) | at least $150,000 but less than $165,000 | the amount you can contribute is reduced

turns: We're married filing jointly and our MAGI was $250,000 in 2025. Can we contribute to Roth IRAs?
cases.behavior: answer: no ($246,000 or more can't contribute)
cases.conditions: MFJ/QSS; modified AGI $246,000 or more.

paragraphs: For 2025, if you are married filing jointly and your modified AGI is $246,000 or more, you can't contribute to a Roth IRA.
claims: married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse | $246,000 or more | you can’t contribute to a Roth IRA.

turns: 2026年夫妻合併申報，收入多少以上就不能存Roth IRA？
cases.behavior: answer: phase-out $242,000–$252,000
cases.conditions: MFJ; adjusted gross income phase-out range 2026.

paragraphs: 2026 年，夫妻合併申報的 Roth IRA 收入逐步遞減範圍是 $242,000 到 $252,000。
claims: the adjusted gross income phase-out range for taxpayers making contributions to a Roth IRA is between $242,000 and $252,000 for married couples filing jointly

turns: What are the Roth IRA income limits for 2026 for a single person?
cases.conditions: Single/HOH; 2026; prior-year values not citable.

paragraphs: For 2026, for singles and heads of household, the Roth IRA income phase-out range is between $153,000 and $168,000.
claims: For singles and heads of household, the income phase-out range is between $153,000 and $168,000

badMock.note: prior-year values from the Notice presented as 2026
paragraphs: For 2026, for singles and heads of household, the Roth IRA income phase-out range is between $150,000 and $165,000.

turns: I'm married but we file separately, and we lived together all of 2025. My MAGI is $40,000. Can I contribute to a Roth IRA?
cases.applicability: filing status: MFS, lived with spouse
cases.behavior: answer: no — MAGI $10,000 or more can't contribute
cases.conditions: MFS and lived with spouse at any time during the year.

claims: married filing separately (and you lived with your spouse at any time during the year) | $10,000 or more | you can’t contribute to a Roth IRA.

turns: 我72歲了，還可以存Roth IRA嗎？
cases.behavior: answer: no age limit (still needs taxable compensation and MAGI under the limit)
cases.conditions: Regardless of age; taxable compensation and MAGI conditions still apply.

claims: Contributions can be made to your Roth IRA regardless of your age.

zhTerms: 符合 IRA 供款規定的應稅工作所得

cases.conditions: Held: §219(b)(1)/§408A(c)(2) authority and a 2026 IRS source required.

cases.topic: Gift from parents in Taiwan (residency unknown)
turns: My parents in Taiwan wired me $150,000 last year. Do I need to report it to the IRS?
cases.behavior: answer conditionally (if the parents are nonresident aliens: Form 3520, more than $100,000) or clarify residency; reporting is not paying tax
forbiddenClaims: (you|they) (will )?(owe|must pay|have to pay|need to pay) (gift |income )?tax on (the|this|that) gift
cases.conditions: U.S. person recipient; donor nonresident alien individual or foreign estate; more than $100,000 aggregated with related persons.

paragraphs: If your parents are nonresident alien individuals, you must report on Form 3520 if you received more than $100,000 from a nonresident alien individual or a foreign estate that you treated as gifts.
claims: More than $100,000 from a nonresident alien individual or a foreign estate (including foreign persons related to that nonresident alien individual or foreign estate) that you treated as gifts or bequests

cases.topic: Gift from NRA parents: tax vs reporting (Chinese)
turns: 我爸媽住在台灣，不是美國人，今年給我20萬美元，要繳稅嗎？還是只要申報？
cases.behavior: answer: report on Form 3520 (more than $100,000 from NRA); do not state that tax is owed
forbiddenClaims: (you|they) (will )?(owe|must pay|have to pay|need to pay) (gift |income )?tax on (the|this|that) gift
cases.conditions: Reporting (申報) is not paying tax (繳稅).

paragraphs: 如果你從非居民外國人收到超過 $100,000、並當作贈與的款項，就要用 Form 3520 申報。
claims: More than $100,000 from a nonresident alien individual or a foreign estate

badMock.note: claims tax is owed (reporting confused with tax liability); figures and donor type are right, so the validator alone cannot catch it
paragraphs: 從非居民外國人收到超過 $100,000 的贈與，你需要為這筆贈與繳稅。
claims: More than $100,000 from a nonresident alien individual or a foreign estate

turns: A Taiwanese company I used to work for sent me a $20,000 'gift'. Do I file Form 3520 for it?
cases.behavior: answer or clarify: a different (section 6039F) threshold applies to foreign corporations; the figure is not in the sources; never apply $100,000; do not decide whether it is really a gift
cases.conditions: Foreign corporation donor: section 6039F threshold amount (not stated in the approved excerpts).

paragraphs: For gifts from foreign corporations, Form 3520 is required when you received more than the section 6039F threshold amount that you treated as gifts. The threshold amount is not stated in the sources here.
claims: More than the section 6039F threshold amount from foreign corporations or foreign partnerships

badMock.note: $100,000 threshold applied to a foreign corporation
paragraphs: You must file Form 3520 if you received more than $100,000 from a foreign corporation that you treated as gifts.
claims: More than $100,000 from a nonresident alien individual or a foreign estate

cases.topic: Threshold for gifts from a foreign company (Chinese)
turns: 外國公司送我的錢超過多少要申報3520？
cases.behavior: answer that the section 6039F threshold applies (amount not in sources) or insufficient; never $100,000
cases.conditions: Foreign corporation threshold not stated in the approved excerpts.

paragraphs: 外國公司給的贈與，門檻是 section 6039F 的門檻金額，不是對非居民外國人的那個門檻；這裡的來源沒有列出這個金額。
claims: More than the section 6039F threshold amount from foreign corporations or foreign partnerships

turns: I got a distribution from my grandfather's trust in Singapore. Do I report it as a foreign gift?
cases.behavior: answer: foreign trust distributions are reported in Part III, not as a gift in Part IV; trust details beyond that are not in the sources
cases.conditions: Foreign trust distribution → Part III (trust rules otherwise excluded).

paragraphs: If a foreign trust makes a distribution to a U.S. person, the U.S. person must report the amount as a distribution in Part III of Form 3520, rather than as a gift in Part IV.
claims: If a foreign trust makes a distribution to a U.S. person, the U.S. person must report the amount as a distribution in Part III, rather than as a gift in Part IV.

turns: 海外信託給我的錢，要用3520的哪一部分申報？
cases.behavior: answer: Part III
cases.conditions: Foreign trust distribution → Part III.

paragraphs: 外國信託給美國人的分配，要在 Form 3520 的 Part III 以分配申報，而不是在 Part IV 當作贈與申報。
claims: If a foreign trust makes a distribution to a U.S. person, the U.S. person must report the amount as a distribution in Part III, rather than as a gift in Part IV.

turns: When is Form 3520 due if I live in the US?
cases.behavior: answer: 15th day of the 4th month after the end of the tax year
cases.conditions: Abroad: 6th month (not this user).

paragraphs: Form 3520 is due by the 15th day of the 4th month following the end of your tax year.
claims: Form 3520 is due by the 15th day of the 4th month following the end of the taxpayer’s tax year.

cases.topic: Late Form 3520 penalty for a foreign gift
turns: I forgot to file Form 3520 for a $200,000 gift from my mom, who lives in Japan and isn't a US person. What's the penalty?
cases.behavior: answer: 5% per month up to 25%; reasonable-cause exception
cases.conditions: §6039F gift penalty only (not the §6677 trust penalties).

paragraphs: If you fail to timely report a foreign gift, a penalty equal to 5% of the amount of the gift applies for each month the failure continues, up to a total of 25%. No penalty applies if you can show the failure was due to reasonable cause and not willful neglect.
claims: a penalty equal to 5% of the amount of such foreign gifts applies for each month for which the failure to report continues (not to exceed a total of 25%)
No penalties will be imposed if the taxpayer can demonstrate that the failure to comply was due to reasonable cause and not willful neglect.

claims: More than $100,000 from a nonresident alien individual or a foreign estate
